title: Extract V4 Guards into the standalone Guard repository
goal: Define an auditable multi-repository program for preserving V4 history in von12549/Guard, validating the standalone product, rebinding IFX as a consumer, and cleaning duplicated V4 product source from IFX without activation or V3 retirement.
acceptanceCriteria: The clean Guard destination, IFX source commit, V4 subtree tree object, repository remotes and feasibility constraints are bound before execution.

Every V4 source and Plan path receives exactly one product, IFX-consumer, historical, retained-evidence or post-gate-cleanup disposition; IFX-only files remain in extracted history but are removed from the active Guard tree during T4.
The Guard repository preserves both its initial lineage and an auditable extracted V4 history with a machine-readable original-to-extracted commit map.
Standalone source paths, plans, CI contracts and tests no longer depend on the IFX docs/guards/v4 layout or implicit release repository identity.

Generic regression, trusted-base negative controls, deterministic packaging, lifecycle, supply-chain, Windows-full and Linux-complete validation pass against one exact Guard commit before publication.
A separately authorized new Guard release is independently verified without rewriting V4 1.1.0 through 1.1.4 historical releases.
IFX is rebound to the exact Guard repository release while IFX-specific Profile, Bundle, review, P10 evidence, coexistence and rollback authority remain in IFX.
Duplicated V4 product source is removed from IFX only after standalone release and IFX consumer revalidation, with provenance and rollback receipts retained.
V4 activation, P10.GATE, ruleset changes and V3/V3_ifx retirement remain false and outside this Plan.
risks: History extraction can lose commit provenance or accidentally import IFX, V3, secret or ignored content.
The OneDrive-hosted destination can experience concurrent sync changes to Git metadata during a bulk import and therefore requires an operator pause and full-hydration attestation.
Source-layout assumptions in tests, CI and release tooling can survive extraction and create hidden IFX coupling.
Moving mixed product and IFX plans can transfer consumer-specific authority into the generic product or lose historical context.
Publishing or cleaning IFX too early can leave no accepted trusted source or rollback path.
A standalone candidate could be allowed to judge its own trusted-base changes.
Combining extraction with activation or V3 retirement would collapse independent trust and rollback boundaries.
decisions: Use the existing public von12549/Guard repository and preserve its initial main lineage.

Extract docs/guards/v4 history from exact IFX commit 80f7b6b65fb06897444a6a36c604c42c93c834e4 (V4 tree af913836d83c071b9c0a769c6c84da4fb727b971) in a disposable no-hardlink clone; Amendment A1 (640c5756) preserved the in-subtree V4-AD-019 acceptance commit and Amendment A2 of 2026-09-27 adds the reconciled published 1.1.4 release lineage (20260927-v4-guards-1-1-4-release-reconciliation).
Use git subtree split rather than requiring unavailable git filter-repo, and preserve the original-to-extracted commit map.
Move generic product plans and TODOs to Guard docs/plans while retaining IFX/P10 adoption authority and evidence in IFX.
Retain IFX-only bytes in extracted Git history for provenance, delete them from the active Guard tree in T4, and create their current IFX successors under docs/guards/v4-adoption only in T7.
Persist all tranche evidence below D:/IFX-Root/v4-todo-008-evidence; temporary clones may be deleted only after their records are copied and hash-verified there.
Treat local Windows acceptance with Linux pending as an intermediate T5 checkpoint; only exact-commit Linux-complete evidence from an authorized T6 CI run completes T5.
Publish only a new standalone semantic version; never recreate or mutate V4 1.1.0 through 1.1.4 tags or assets.
Switch canonical development authority only after Guard review, exact-commit certification, standalone release verification and an IFX handoff decision.
Delete duplicated IFX V4 product source only after IFX consumes and revalidates the standalone release.
Require separate explicit authorization for every remote write, release publication and protected IFX cleanup tranche.
Leave V4 activation, P10.GATE and V3/V3_ifx retirement to later Plans.
